steps.text: Add webhook rate-limit tunables (max requests and window length) to loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults, following the existing tunable patterns.
steps.test: Config test: defaults returned when env is unset, overrides parsed and invalid values rejected when set.

steps.text: Create src/rate-limit.ts: an in-memory limiter keyed by tenant id with an injectable clock. consume() returns allowed/denied plus ms until reset, denied calls do not extend the window, and expired entries are pruned.
steps.test: Limiter unit test: tenant A denied after max in window, tenant B unaffected, allowance returns after window passes.

steps.text: Wire the limiter into createDeps/createApp in src/app.ts, constructed from config by default and overridable through deps so tests can inject a small limit or fake clock.
steps.test: App test: createApp() builds with the default limiter and accepts an injected limiter with a tiny limit.

steps.text: In POST /webhooks in src/routes/webhooks.ts, after the existing tenant check and before reading the body, consume one unit for that tenant; on denial return 429 with Retry-After in whole seconds and skip handling.
steps.test: Route test: the (limit+1)th POST returns 429 with Retry-After >= 1 and the webhook handler is not invoked.

steps.text: Add integration tests: under-limit webhooks for a tenant succeed, the same tenant over the limit gets 429 with Retry-After, and a different tenant still succeeds within the same window.
steps.test: test/webhooks.rate-limit.test.ts passes, including cross-tenant isolation and Retry-After assertions.

steps.text: Run the full test suite plus typecheck/lint if configured, and fix any regressions, confirming other routes and under-limit webhooks are unchanged.
steps.test: Full test suite green, with only POST /webhooks behaviour changed.

risks.text: In-memory state is per-process: restarts clear quotas and multiple instances would each allow the full limit, so enforcement is only approximate if the app is scaled out.
A Map keyed by tenant id grows unbounded if expired entries are not pruned, leaking memory as tenant count grows.
A fixed window permits up to 2x the limit in a burst straddling a window boundary; a sliding window would be needed for a hard cap.
If consume() is split into an async check-then-increment, concurrent requests from one tenant can race past the limit; the consume must be synchronous and atomic.
Retry-After in milliseconds, or rounded down to 0, would violate the header contract and could make clients retry immediately in a hot loop.

decisions.text: In-memory fixed-window per-tenant limiter, injected via createDeps; no external store.
decisions.why: Matches the wiring in src/app.ts and keeps the suite self-contained; multi-instance limits are noted in R1.

decisions.text: Rate-limit key is the tenant validated by the existing tenant check, not source IP or an unverified header.
decisions.why: Prevents spoofed headers or shared IPs from exhausting another tenant's quota.

decisions.text: Limiter runs after tenant validation and before the request body is read.
decisions.why: A tenant id is required for keying, and denied requests avoid body-parsing cost.

decisions.text: All limit and window numbers come from loadConfig() with defaults; no literals in routes.
decisions.why: src/config.ts is the established home for every tunable number.

decisions.text: Denied requests do not consume quota or extend the window; Retry-After is ceil(seconds until reset).
decisions.why: Keeps Retry-After accurate and prevents a retrying tenant from postponing its own recovery.

payload.text:
Done. Admin routes now answer 429 with `Retry-After` over the limit.

decision: Admin routes share the existing webhook rate limiter and config (`RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS` / `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`) under a dedicated `__admin__` bucket key, applied as middleware to all admin routes.

What changed:

- [src/routes/admin.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0043-r1/src/routes/admin.ts): added middleware on the admin group that consumes one token per request from the shared `RateLimiter` and returns `{ "error": "rate limit exceeded" }` with 429 plus a `Retry-After` header (seconds, minimum 1), mirroring the webhook handler. Covers both `GET /admin/tenants` and `POST /admin/tenants`, so a runaway script cannot flood tenant creation. The `__admin__` key uses characters invalid in tenant ids, so it can never collide with per-tenant webhook buckets. No new config keys, no new dependencies, no audit entry on rejected requests.
- [test/admin.rate-limit.test.ts](<fixture>/.stint/worktrees/T-0043-r1/test/admin.rate-limit.test.ts): new tests for 429 with `Retry-After` on excess tenant creation, the shared read/write bucket, and bucket isolation from webhook traffic.

Verification I ran: `bun run typecheck` clean and `bun run test` showed 8 files / 33 tests passing in ~0.8s. The daemon's own test run after this turn is the record, not mine.

What I did not finish: nothing outstanding against the acceptance criteria.

What I did not look at: `src/lib/store.ts`, `src/lib/audit.ts`, `src/lib/backoff.ts`, `src/server.ts`, and the events/audit route tests beyond confirming they still pass.
